<!--
Use an English Conventional Commit title: type(scope): imperative subject
Example: feat(market): add a pre-market sentiment summary

PR 标题使用英文 Conventional Commits 格式，例如：
feat(market): add a pre-market sentiment summary
-->

## Background

<!-- Explain the user problem and why this change is needed.
说明用户问题及本次改动的必要性。 -->

## Changes

<!-- Group implementation and behavior changes by module.
按模块说明实现与行为变化。 -->

## Validation

<!-- List exact commands actually run and their results. Do not claim unrun checks.
列出实际执行的命令和结果；请勿声明未执行的检查。 -->

## Boundaries and risks

<!-- Describe compatibility, untested paths, migrations, or known limitations.
说明兼容性、未测试路径、迁移及已知限制。 -->

## Follow-up

<!-- List only concrete work intentionally deferred, or write None.
仅列出明确延后的事项；若无请写 None。 -->
